questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to survive alone in a forest with no food or tools
Why the pandemic made so many people feel lonely
The life and teachings of the philosopher Confucius
Why some people choose to live alone, away from society
questions.why: Neil says they'll hear some of the reasons why people choose to be a hermit.

questions.q: How does Rob feel about spending time alone?
options: He loves it and wants much more time alone
He's had to do it, but he'd rather see friends
He finds it relaxing and peaceful after work
He has never spent a whole day on his own
questions.why: Rob says it wouldn't be his choice: 'I'd much rather be socialising and visiting friends'.

questions.q: How long did Christopher Wright live alone in the forests of Maine?
options: Nearly 30 years
Forty days and nights
About three years
Just one winter
questions.why: Neil says he lived in complete isolation for nearly 30 years.

questions.q: According to Meng Hu, what did Confucius advise people to do when the Emperor was evil?
options: Fight against him
Leave China for another country
Withdraw from public life and live apart
Serve him anyway
questions.why: The dictum was 'When the Emperor is good, serve. When the Emperor is evil, recluse'.

questions.q: Where did the Chinese educated men who dropped out go, according to Meng Hu?
options: To the Emperor's palace
To big cities
To temples in the mountains
To small villages and farms
questions.why: He says they would migrate to small villages, to farms.

questions.q: What did hippies in the 1960s have in common with hermits, according to Neil?
options: They lived together in forests and caves
They wanted to challenge society's rules
They wanted to be alone, away from family
They were very religious and prayed often
questions.why: Neil says both shared the desire to challenge society's rules and conventions.

questions.q: Why did Sara Maitland spend forty days alone on the Isle of Skye?
options: To write a book about Scotland
To escape from her family
To look for God in silence
To study wild animals
questions.why: She spent forty days alone seeking God in the silence of the remote island.

questions.q: What advice does Sara Maitland give parents?
options: Offer time alone as a reward, not a punishment
Send children to their room when they are bad
Never leave children alone
Teach children to talk more
questions.why: She says never use 'go to your room' as a punishment – use it as a reward, a treat.
